title: TSUDAKOMA NC Rotary Tables — Explanation of Indexing Accuracy and Clamp Torque
locator: Manufacturer explanation of indexing accuracy derived from equal indexing around one table revolution and distinction between clamp torque and worm-gear self-locking contribution
notes: Product-family-specific manufacturer terminology and measurement explanation. Its indexing accuracy definition should not be silently equated with ISO 230-2 parameter definitions. The page explicitly distinguishes the clamping mechanism's torque from worm-gear self-locking contribution; do not generalize its rated pressures or torque values to other products.
